content.text: Without using any tools, explain in markdown why a Feed list re-renders every row when one row changes. Use exactly this shape: a level-2 heading, one short paragraph that mentions `feed.rows` and `revision` as inline code and links to [ADR 0007](https://example.com/adr/0007), a numbered list of three short steps, a tsx code block of two or three lines, a two-column table with a header row and two rows (Row state, Redraws), and one closing sentence. Keep the whole answer under 160 words.

## Feed Re-rendering All Rows

When `feed.rows` changes or the parent's `revision` counter increments, React can't differentiate individual rows without stable keys. See [ADR 0007](https://example.com/adr/0007) for key management guidelines. Each update triggers reconciliation of the entire list, causing unnecessary re-renders even when only one row changed.

1. Parent component updates `feed.rows` or increments `revision`
2. React re-renders the Feed component with new props
3. All row components unmount and remount due to missing or unstable keys

```tsx
feed.rows.map((row, index) => <Row key={index} data={row} />)
// Each change causes all rows to re-render
```

| Row state | Redraws |
|-----------|---------|
| One row added | All rows |
| One row updated | All rows |

Without stable keys or memoization, React can't preserve row identity across renders.

output.status_detail: identified feed re-render issue: unstable keys cause full list refresh
